views.title: Sign in
views.blurb: The one pre-team surface every client shares: one Continue list with the OIDC providers the instance advertises, email and passkey.

views.blurb: Name the team you will own: the wizard’s create branch on web and desktop, the sheet behind the board switcher’s New team row on the phones.

notes.android: The mobile wizard puts the Create and Join cards on ONE step (TeamSetupView / OnboardingScreen), so this branch is not a screen of its own there — see `onboarding`.

views.title: Devices
views.blurb: The machines that can run a coding session: the caller's desktops and headless servers, each listing the agent logins it holds — identity, health and its rate-limit numbers. A row starts nothing: its one control is a settings gear that opens Device settings.

views.title: Actions
views.blurb: The action catalog: one row per reusable agent run, each with its play button. Phones reach it through its own Actions tab and list every team's actions grouped by team (EXP-1186/1187); web md+ and desktop through the sidebar's Actions entry.

notes.web: EXP-686 gave Actions its own top-level route on every client; SLOP-5 moved the entry behind More, EXP-1187 made it a phone tab again (the composer's action chip is the everyday way to run one). A desktop viewport shows the list alone — the seeds live in Getting started; the phone keeps Actions and Suggestions behind ?tab=. A row opens the action's page.

views.title: Agent
views.blurb: The Agent page: the composer — the ONE launcher since EXP-825 — here empty: a free prompt bound to no issue that needs no repository. EXP-923 moved the runs off the page: what is RUNNING is a section of the sidebar, and the history sits behind the page's own toggle.

notes.web: EXP-923: the page is the COMPOSER alone. My live runs are the sidebar's Running section, and Recent is a panel behind the ghost history button at the page's top-left — so the shot shows a full-width composer, not a list.
notes.web-mobile: EXP-923: the phone keeps the Running list under the composer; Recent left the page for the header's history button, which opens it as a bottom sheet.
notes.desktop: EXP-1192: the IDE LANDS here on startup, and Agent is the rail's first entry (above Inbox). The page is the COMPOSER alone; my live runs are the rail's own Running section. The ghost history button at the page's top-left slides Recent runs in as a second sidebar INSIDE the content card and turns into a Back button while it is open. `EXP_DEV_SCREEN=chat` opens the page; add `EXP_DEV_TOOL=history` for the Recent runs sidebar.

views.title: Agent · Issues
views.blurb: The composer with work attached: one chip per picked issue above the prompt, the machine and agent pickers under it. Two issues off the board, handed to one run.

notes.web: `issues` is a one-shot search param, a csv of issue uuids. `$issueA`/`$issueB` resolve to APP-3 and APP-6 (apps/web/scripts/lib/demo-ids.ts): two codeable issues on the repo-backed board that no seeded session runs on, the first being the issue the phone store slide starts coding from — hence the anchor on its chip. Needs `bun run screenshots:desktop`: without an online machine the device picker is empty.
notes.desktop: The same query string on the dev screen, `EXP_DEV_SCREEN=chat?issues=<a>,<b>` (EXP-825), paired with `EXP_DEV_TOOL=agent` by the lane.

views.title: Agent · Action
views.blurb: The composer running the builtin Fix merge conflicts with an open PR picked — its own look (EXP-1233): the headline names the PR's issue as a chip, the card under it is the PR row (number, branch → base, the picker) and, after a refused merge, the refusal line. A saved action with inputs keeps the generic action chip and its typed fields.

notes.web: `action` names the action (a row id or a builtin id), `pr` the issue whose open PR prefills the builtin's required `pr` input: `$prIssue` resolves to APP-14, the seeded issue on the real review PR; `conflict=1` (EXP-1233) = a refused merge opened it, so the card shows the refusal line. Needs `bun run screenshots:desktop` like chat-issues.
notes.desktop: `EXP_DEV_SCREEN=chat?action=builtin:fix-conflicts&pr=<issue-uuid>&conflict=1`, paired with `EXP_DEV_TOOL=agent` by the lane.

views.title: Steering a session
views.blurb: One coding session on its own page: it opens as the status row over the run's results thread with the agent's open question still in place, Show work expands the full scrubbed transcript, and the reply box answers it.

notes.web: EXP-740 gave a session its own full-page route and EXP-870 made it the ONE run URL (an issue's run included — the issue is its work tab's other face), so there is no recipe to expand: `$sessionId` resolves to DEMO_STEERED_SESSION_ID (apps/web/scripts/screenshot-demo.ts), the id the seed stamps on the demo user's running showcase run. Needs `bun run screenshots:desktop` running: the feed is relay-fed, and an unreachable relay photographs a Reconnecting state instead. The anchor is the tail fragment of DEMO_FEED_QUESTION. EXP-1175: the shot now photographs the THREAD (status row + results, the pending question card in place); set localStorage `exp.showWork:<userId>` to `true` to photograph the transcript.
notes.desktop: A session is a `Screen::Session` tab in the center panel since EXP-746, not a dock, and `session:$steeredSession` opens the seeded showcase run in it. With no engine of its own the tab dials the relay as a VIEWER (owner-only ticket via `steer.mintTicket`), so it renders the same relay-fed feed the web shot photographs — which makes `bun run screenshots:desktop` and the steer-relay container prerequisites here too, exactly as they are for web. Without them the tab photographs a Reconnecting / steering-unavailable state, so `--skip-relay` skips this view instead.

notes.desktop: See web: the IDE's Start coding button opens the same chat-issues screen.

views.title: Reviews

notes.desktop: EXP-1192: a full-width list in the main content card beside the full rail. A row opens its issue's Guide in a tab (no second sidebar since EXP-1248; see guide).

views.title: Complete diff
views.blurb: A PR's whole diff as the Guide's Show complete diff page (`?view=guide&section=all`; the legacy `?view=diff` lands here): the file TREE beside the file cards, every card open. APP-14 fetches a genuine patch from GitHub.

notes.web: The diff is fetched live from GitHub, so this view is the slowest in the catalog and the most network-flaky. Keep the generous anchor timeout. EXP-916: every file card starts OPEN (only a file past contract.diffUi.collapseThresholdLines folds itself), so the recipe only WAITS for the first hunk row of the first card and clicks its header just in case; the anchor is a line of the first card's own patch (strings.xml's added feature_topic_api_error string). EXP-1251: the page sits under the Guide (a back row to it); on md+ the file tree is the column beside the cards, the phone lists the files in the bar's sheet beside the white Merge capsule.
notes.desktop: EXP-1251: the issue tab's Guide owns the diff pages (`steer_viewer` guide_page) and nothing deep-links straight to the complete diff any more, so `issue:<id>?face=guide` lands on the Guide; the desktop half of this view is the `guide` drive until a page deep link exists.
notes.ios: EXP-1251: 05_review opens the issue from Reviews on its Guide, then taps the Changes row (else Show complete diff) and waits for guide-section-page + changes-file-row before the shot.
notes.android: EXP-1251: 5_review shoots the GUIDE face (work-guide + guide-changes-row; the pop-out stays on the bare work-merge-pr capsule), not a section page.

views.title: Run changes
views.blurb: The PR diff of an ISSUE-LESS run (a chat or action run's own pull request, EXP-1194) on the run's Guide: the same file cards as the issue's Guide pages, fed by codingSessions.prFiles, opened from the Reviews "Agent runs" row. A teammate's run, so it reads read-only.

notes.web: EXP-1204. The run is Jonas's finished chat run (seed `DEMO_SESSION_IDS.runChanges`), so the demo user is a TEAMMATE and the page is `TeammateRunGuide`: the stub header with the GitHub button over the run's Guide, read-only, no steer ticket. `?view=guide&section=all` opens the Guide's Show complete diff page (every file card, the file tree beside them on md+), the same page review-diff captures for an issue. The owner's own run draws the same Guide on its run face. Like review-diff the diff is fetched live from GitHub (`codingSessions.prFiles` → the run's `pr_url`), which also insists the PR's repo is a TEAM repository: the seed registers it (`android/kotlin`, an ARCHIVED repo on purpose — a team repo's OPEN PRs would land in the Reviews queue as an external group, and an archived repo can never grow one). The anchor is a line of the first file's own patch (the ResolverImpl import #125 adds).
notes.desktop: EXP_DEV_RUN_FACE=guide-all lands the run tab on the Guide's Show complete diff page (the same page the web route opens).
notes.ios: EXP-1251: the Reviews 'Agent runs' row opens the run on its Guide; the flow taps the Guide's Changes row (else Show complete diff), waits for guide-section-page, then changes-file-row, and shoots the section page.
notes.android: EXP-1251: the review-run-row opens RunChangesScreen on the Guide; the flow taps guide-changes-row, waits for guide-section + changes-file-row, shoots, then backs out twice.

views.title: Guide
views.blurb: An issue's Guide face (EXP-1251: Changes + Results merged into one face): the Stack card while its PR sits in an open stack, the Summary lead, numbered sections with ONE Changes row each, the automatic Other changes section and Show complete diff. APP-14 has a PR and no report, so its whole diff is one Changes section.

notes.web: EXP-1251: the coverage counts the PR files fetched live from GitHub (like review-diff), so the anchor waits for the Show complete diff row the loaded diff draws.
notes.desktop: EXP-1251: the issue tab's Guide face (`issue:<id>?face=guide`; the legacy results/diff/changes words land here too); `EXP_DEV_TOOL=reviews` pins the Reviews origin the way a Reviews row opens it.

views.title: Guide section
views.blurb: A Guide section's diff as a page under the Guide (`?view=guide&section=N`): a back row to the Guide naming the section and its counts, the file tree in the column beside the same file cards every diff draws, only that section's files (phones: the cards and the bar's file sheet, filtered).

notes.web: EXP-1251: APP-14 has no report, so the PR body is its one unnumbered section claiming the whole diff (`section=1`; there is no `other` page); the anchor is a line of the first card's own patch, as on review-diff.
notes.desktop: EXP-1251: a section page is state inside the Guide (`SteerSessionView::open_guide_page`) with no dev deep link yet, so the desktop half is not driven.

notes.web-mobile: No phone-browser shot: the site's live render is the responsive web view, and the iOS and Android shots are the phone frames.

views.title: Exponential UI · Resizable
views.blurb: Panels split by draggable handles. The core catalog specimen (its example and variants, captioned) of ui.exponential.at/components/resizable/.

notes.web-mobile: No phone-browser shot: the site's live render is the responsive web view, and the iOS and Android shots are the phone frames.

views.title: Session rows
views.blurb: ONE SessionRow in two sizes (EXP-1248): the sidebar's small one-line row and the big two-line row the Recent list and the phone Running list draw, the run mark at 12 + 14·depth on every row, children always shown, no fold chevron, the device glyph trailing in both sizes.

notes.web: The styleguide island `session-row` (apps/styleguide/src/entries/session-row.tsx) draws both sizes on the real component; the app views are `agents` and the sidebar.
notes.web-mobile: See web: the phone's Running list and the Recent sheet draw the big row (`agents` web-mobile).
notes.desktop: The desktop styleguide entry `session_row.rs` draws both sizes; the app views are the rail and Recent.

views.title: PR rows
views.blurb: ONE PrRow (EXP-1248): a one-line PR row with the ring lead, nested with tree guides for a PR tree and railed top-first down to the base branch for a stack (the Guide's stack card and the Reviews list share it).

notes.web: The styleguide island `pr-row` (apps/styleguide/src/entries/pr-row.tsx); the app views are `reviews` and `guide`.
notes.web-mobile: See web: `reviews` and `guide` inherit their phone captures.
notes.desktop: The desktop styleguide entry `pr_row.rs`; the app views are Reviews and the Guide.

views.title: Composer + menu
views.blurb: The composer's ONE "+" menu (EXP-1249, fixture composer-menu.json): Implement issue, Run action, Add file or image, Effort, Subagents, Ultracode, MCP servers, Computer use; a dropdown at desktop widths and a bottom sheet on phones.

notes.web: The styleguide `menu` and `composer-dialog` entries show the open menu; the app view is `chat`.
notes.web-mobile: See web: on phones the same entries open as a bottom sheet.
notes.desktop: The desktop styleguide `menu` entry draws the real "+" menu (`chat_screen::plus_menu`).

views.title: Exponential UI · Row
